summary: BioRestorative Therapies filed an 8-K reporting a Revolving Loan Agreement with Bowery Group LLC for up to $1,000,000 at 12% interest, maturing one year from each loan. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The filing also notes director resignations and appointments tied to the agreement. This is a routine debt financing arrangement, not a special situation. No special-situation attributes such as a transformative M&A, tender offer, spin-off, or activist campaign are present. The director changes appear consequential to the loan terms but are not themselves a forced departure event warranting a Management Changes classification.
